scenes.headline:
ChatGPT just moved
inside Microsoft Word.
scenes.body: And yes — OpenAI says it works on every ChatGPT plan, including Free.

scenes.headline:
No more constant
copy-paste.
scenes.body: ChatGPT now opens in a sidebar beside the document you're already working on.

scenes.headline: What can it do?
scenes.body: Draft from notes. Summarize documents. Rewrite selected text. Reorganize headings, numbering and formatting.

scenes.headline: This is the real shift.
scenes.body: AI is moving from a separate chat window into the tools professionals already use every day.

scenes.headline: How to try it
scenes.body: Install the ChatGPT Microsoft add-in, open it from Word's ribbon, sign in, then work from the sidebar.

scenes.headline: One thing to know
scenes.body: Your ChatGPT plan limits still apply, and workplace admins can restrict the add-in.

scenes.headline: This is what practical AI looks like.
scenes.body: Less switching. More building. Follow @buildwith_pankaj for AI updates that actually matter at work.
